judged_text: The findFirst-then-update/create sequence is a check-then-insert with no unique constraint on (userId, appId) backing it. Two concurrent webhook deliveries for the same user+app both see no existing credential and both insert, leaving duplicate Credential rows; downstream code that does findFirst will pick one arbitrarily and the other becomes unreachable stale credentials.
